newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices down in low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices down in low volumes.

text.p: Most Bucharest stock prices inched down on Wednesday amid low interest from buyers, pushing the exchange turnover down at 7.8 billion lei from a previous 10.7 billion, traders said.
"Investors remained focused on the first-tier stock Arctic which saw high demand. But that was not enough to boost the overall market," said one broker.
Arctic refrigerator maker added seven percent on the average price but closed 50 lei weaker at 3,600 after dipping in late trading from a peak of 3,700 lei at midday.
Three independent market indices, the VAB, the BIG and the CAS-SE, based on average prices and market capitalisation, slipped by 1.1, 1.17 and 1.11 percent respectively from Tuesday.
In terms of average prices, 29 stocks slipped on Wednesday, 18 rose, one stayed flat and two had no trades. Ready-made factory Dorobantul stayed suspended.
Operators said some buying orders might emerge in the market on Thursday and Friday as local investment funds seemed ready to place their assets on the exchange.
Low liquidity kept trading in second-tier stocks subdued on Wednesday and no major recovery was expected in the next few days, brokers said.
Data showed small-caps achieved only about nine percent of the overall turnover.
